title: Porsche 918 vs LaFerrari: The Difference Nobody Explains
description:
The Porsche nine eighteen Spyder and the Ferrari LaFerrari arrived within months of each other in twenty thirteen, both hybrids, both limited, both the fastest road cars their makers had ever built. But the numbers show two very different ideas of what a hybrid hypercar should be. One leans on its electric motors, the other on a huge V12. Here is the comparison, side by side, with every figure sourced. We use Wikipedia's pages for both cars, Porsche's own press release, evo, Motorious, Sotheby's, RM Sotheby's, Broad Arrow and the duPont Registry. Where a figure is a manufacturer claim, we say so. Where two sources disagree, we show both. And where we compare numbers measured in different units or on different tracks, we warn you before we do the sum.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
